visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with wavy dark hair sits at a desk, looking down at an open silver laptop; the lighting is warm and bright. (2) The scene cuts to him looking up at the ceiling while holding a red game controller, followed by him lying on a dark couch scrolling through a smartphone. (3) He is startled as another man—identical in appearance—enters through a wooden door wearing a black t-shirt; the setting is a modern indoor living room with a shelf full of items in the background. (4) The second man poses dramatically with his hands above his head in a heart shape as glowing light effects surround him. (5) A purple bottle of liquid supplement is held close to the camera, showing a gold cap and a label with Traditional Chinese text. (6) The second man drinks from the bottle while large white and yellow text overlays appear against a dark background. (7) He presents a larger purple box of the same brand while gesturing with a peace sign; the lighting shifts to a higher contrast with lens flare effects. (8) The original man is seen back on the couch, smiling while looking at his phone. (9) He is then shown at his desk again, tearing open a small purple jelly stick and eating it while multiple boxes of the supplement sit on the table nearby.
